title: Mai Watan Na Jaongi Mai Watan Na Jaongi
body:
Tha Rabab Ka Nouha Loot Gaya Mera Kunba
Mai Watan Na Jaongi Mai Watan Na Jaongi
Nainawa Ke Maqtal Me Qatal Ho-Gaye Sarwar
Sham Me Sakina Hai Karbala Me Hai Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ho Ke Bekas-o-Tanha Mai Watan Na Jaungi
Mai Ne Apni Aankhon Se Ghar Ujadte Dekha Hai
Mai Ne Apne Bache Ke Sar Ko Kat-Te Dekha Hai
Leke Qali Gaih-Wara Mai Watan Na Jaongi
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab Watan Se Nikli Thi Aap Bhi The Bicche Bhi
Karbala Me Kya Aayi Goud Ho Gayi Qali Aur Suhag Bhi Ujda Mai Watan Na Jaongi
Qaid-e-sham Se Chutkar Mai Yaha Na Aapati
Sath Hi Sakina Ke Kash Mai Bhi Marjati
<<DIVIDER>>
Dagh Leke Bacchi Ka Mai Watan Na Jaongi
Kya Karo Waha Jakar Aap Hi Bata-Di-Jiye
Apne Qabr Me Wali Ab Mujhe Chipa-Li-Jiye
Kaun Hai Waha Mera Mai Watan Na Jaongi
<<DIVIDER>>
Sabr Ka Kiya Wada Sabr Kar Liya Maine
Har Qadam Musibat Par Shukr-e-Rab Kiya Maine
Ab Yehi Hai Maroza Mai Watan Na Jaongi
